# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_STACK_BOS_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon is in perfect bullish stacked alignment (5>8>13>21>34) and price breaks above the prior swing high by at least 0.15% with expanding volume (>1.4x 20-bar average), a high-probability intraday trend continuation setup emerges. This edge exists because it combines multi-timeframe momentum alignment (ribbon) with structural break confirmation and volume expansion, filtering weak breakouts and capturing the initiation of sustained directional moves.

## Mechanism

**Entry:**  
- Ribbon bullish stacked: 5 EMA > 8 EMA > 13 EMA > 21 EMA > 34 EMA (all on 5m timeframe)  
- Price makes new higher high (HH) exceeding prior swing high by ≥0.15%  
- Volume of breakout bar > 1.4x average volume of last 20 bars  
- Enter long at close of breakout bar  

**Exit:**  
- Primary stop: chart-stop at prior swing low (structure invalidation)  
- Profit-take: TP1 at 2R (risk = entry price - stop level)  
- Runner: trail stop at 25% below high-water mark (HWM) after TP1 hit  
- Time stop: 15:50 ET
